consent.body: Send anonymous gameplay stats to the developer.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Rushwarden keeps your progress on this device. With stats on, it sends a few gameplay events (rounds, results, cards played) with a random install ID, the platform, game version, language setting and a device class (low, mid or high). Never your name, email, location or an advertising ID.
privacy.collectsNothing: This build collects nothing: no stats and no install ID.
privacy.noInstall: Stats are off, so there is no install ID.
privacy.email: To ask about your data, email us this ID.
privacy.deletePending: Your delete request hasn’t gone through yet. Nothing is being sent. Try again.
privacy.deleteFailed: Couldn’t reach the server. Try again later.

rules.title: How to play
rules.round: Each round, play up to {plays} cards from your hand ({energy} energy; most cards cost 1), then press Go.
rules.go: Traffic runs for {seconds} seconds. Every vehicle that leaves the map adds its points to your total; ones still on the road at the end don’t count. Reach the quota to pass.
rules.lose: A missed quota or a gridlock (traffic stops moving) costs 1 of your {approval} approval. Lose them all and the run is over.
rules.win: Get through all {rounds} rounds to hold the district. Passing a round lets you add a card to your deck.
rules.stripes: Orange stripes at a road’s end show the traffic coming in there: the stronger the stripe, the more vehicles.
rules.closed: Grey roads with red bars are closed this round: no traffic enters them, and trips route around.
tip.title: First round.
tip.body: Play up to {plays} cards, then Go. Traffic that leaves the map counts toward the quota. A miss or a gridlock costs 1 of {approval} approval; survive {rounds} rounds to hold the district.
tip.stripes: Orange stripes at road ends show incoming traffic.
